item.title: Zhonggu spreads its wings to meet manufacturing shift
item.description: Zhonggu Logistics, China’s largest coastal container carrier, expects to diversify more into intra-Asia shipping as Chinese manufacturing shifts to other locations, especially within Asia. This has resulted in some volumes moving away from inland waterways to intra-Asia routes and, as a result, Zhonggu is switching to mid-sized vessels that can carry more containers.
